title: Haste Spore Flask
summary: Throw as an Action to make a 10 ft radius cloud of Haste Spores.

fields.Throw: Single use, up to 60 ft. Sovereign Spaw can grant this flask.
fields.Haste Spores: For 1 turn, an affected creature gets +2 AC, advantage on Dexterity saves, +30 ft movement and an extra Action without Lethargic afterward. Honour Mode removes Extra Attack from the extra Action, and Slowed can remove the effect.
fields.Base value: 50 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.
fields.Cloud duration: The primary item gives the affected creature’s duration but does not specify how long this flask’s cloud lasts.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 gameplay and pinned item and dependency revisions. Reconciled applicable action, condition, and variant details against pinned rules.
